caseNameFull: Clarence F. Birdseye v. Arthur Woods, Police Commissioner of the City of New York and Kellogg Birdseye v. Arthur Woods, Police Commissioner of the City of New York
summary: Appeals from the District Court of the United States for the Southern District of New York,.

opinions.text:

Judgments affirmed with costs upon the authority of Munsey v. Clough, 196 U. S. 364, 373; Pierce v. Creecy, 210 U. S. 387, 401, 402, 404, 405; Drew v. Thaw, 235 U. S. 432, 439-440.
